regression_found_and_fixed: During the experiment campaign the suite fell to 42/52. Root cause was NOT the experiment code: advanced.py called Bm25Index.search directly for the sparse transcript path, bypassing the _ns_ok namespace predicate applied by every other retrieval path. Under a tenant-scoped query it returned 10/10 out-of-namespace transcript chunks. Those leaked hits also outranked in-namespace documents and won source selection, zeroing citations on vertical queries. The defect was PRE-EXISTING and latent; it became observable only when the corpus grew from 10.3k to 17.6k chunks (auto-saved voice transcripts) and the leaked hits began to outrank real ones.
fixes_applied: index.py: new search_transcript_only_sparse() enforcing _ns_ok (verified 10 leaked hits -> 0)
advanced.py: transcript sparse path routed through the filtered wrapper
index.py: namespace candidate pool now scales with corpus size instead of a fixed 512, so small-namespace starvation does not silently return as the KB grows
voice_changes: session.py: additive 'loop' field (L_I / L_G) on assistant messages — required to make invariant I1 measurable at all; ignored by existing clients
session.py: VOICE_ABLATION_MODE env/file switch for E10 arms; default 'dual_i1' is the shipped behaviour, so production is unchanged
non_regression_evidence: voice E2E after changes: first audio +0.28 s casual, +0.93 s RAG, word-perfect STT
golden eval 49/52 with doc-precision 0.98 after the isolation fix
all five retrieval paths audited: 0 out-of-namespace hits across 359 checked
